title: SaaS platform partners
snippet:
SaaS platforms can join the Stripe Partner Ecosystem at two tiers: Stripe Partner and Premier Partner. Stripe Partners can access on-demand resources and revenue sharing, while Premier Partners get additional advisory services, enhanced support, and market development funds (MDF).
## Stripe Partner and Premier Partner requirements
Stripe Partners need to meet the following SaaS platform technical and business requirements:
- Use [Stripe Connect](https://stripe.com/connect) to access Stripe accounts and data.
- Process at least 1 million USD in payment volume annually.
- Use [Payment Intents](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents).
- Set up Stripe [webhook](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks) endpoints for [Connect events](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/webhooks).
- Create a landing page that describes your Stripe integration.
- Use Checkout Sessions.
- Use Stripe [Checkout](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout) or [Payment Element](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-element) to tokenize payment information.
- Use [idempotency keys](https://docs.stripe.com/error-low-level#idempotency).

### Stripe Connect revenue sharing program
Partners in the SaaS platform track using Stripe Connect are eligible for the revenue sharing program, which enables your company to grow as your customers expand with Stripe.

title: Stripe Partner Ecosystem
snippet:
The Stripe Partner Ecosystem (SPE) is a program that provides benefits, incentives, and resources to help partners grow with Stripe and deliver greater value to shared users. SPE features trusted partners who integrate with, extend, advocate for, and build on Stripe—helping businesses launch faster, operate more efficiently, and scale with confidence.
## Join Stripe Partner Ecosystem
Stripe Partner Ecosystem supports four primary partner tracks: Services, SaaS platforms, Apps, and Payment methods. The Technology track is available by invitation only. During the application process, partners can indicate which tracks interest them, and Stripe confirms the best fit.
To become a Stripe partner, you must:
1. Create and activate a free [Stripe account](https://dashboard.stripe.com/register).
2. Make sure you’re not on the [Stripe Restricted Businesses list](https://www.stripe.com/restricted-businesses).
3. Meet the requirements of the individual track.
4. Complete the [partner application](https://www.stripe.com/partners/become-a-partner).
5. Accept the [Stripe Partner Ecosystem Agreement](https://www.stripe.com/legal/partner-ecosystem).

Partners receive the following core benefits:
- Access to training and certifications.
- Marketing campaign assets, how-to guides, and templates.
- Stripe Partner badges and co-branding guidelines.
- Market development funds (MDF).
- [Partner directory listing](https://stripe.com/partners).
- Deal registration to request co-selling support.
- Partner portal access.
- Partner program support.

The Stripe Partner Ecosystem maintains a network of trusted partners. In April 2026, we updated the program to raise the bar for participation. Partners must now meet clear baseline standards across technical expertise, business impact, and customer success to help ensure high-quality integrations and outcomes for your customers.
The program includes two tiers:
- Partner
- Premier
All partners complete a vetting process and enter the program at the Partner tier. They can advance to the Premier tier when they meet additional track-specific criteria, and unlock additional benefits.
## Partner program tracks, requirements and tailored benefits
Partners must satisfy the minimum requirements for the track they’re interested in applying to. The Technology track is available by invitation only. Track-specific requirements are intended to guarantee technical competence, measurable business impact, and positive customer outcomes.

title: Partner requirements and best practices
snippet:
### Business Requirements
- Have a minimum of 5 active [connected accounts](/docs/connect)
- Create a Stripe-specific landing page that explains your integration (e.g., [Xero example](https://www.xero.com/us/partnerships/stripe/))
- Provide required [partner listing links](/docs/partners/listing-information)
- Adhere to [Stripe brand and trademark guidelines](/about/resources). For example, while you may reference your partnership with us, or note that your offering works “with Stripe” or “for Stripe”, or is “powered by Stripe”, you may not use “Stripe” as part of the name of your offering (including, for example, in your domain name, social media handle, app name, etc.).
### Integration Requirements
- Use [Stripe Connect](/docs/connect) to access Stripe accounts and data
- Set up a Stripe [webhook](/docs/webhooks) endpoint for [Connect events](/docs/connect/webhooks)
- Specify a [Stripe API version](/docs/api#versioning) for all requests that is [less than 18 months old](/docs/upgrades#api-changelog)
- Use [Checkout](/docs/payments/checkout) or [Elements](/docs/stripe-js) to tokenize payment information
- Use [PaymentIntents](/docs/payments/payment-intents)
